newsitem.title: JAPAN: Alps Elec up on technology development.
newsitem.headline: Alps Elec up on technology development.

text.p: Alps Electric Co Ltd shares rose on Thursday, boosted by news that it, Ichikoh Industries Ltd, Tohoku University and an unlisted company had jointly developed a new technology that cuts production costs for liquid crystal displays (LCDs), brokers said.
As of 0400 GMT, the shares were up 40 yen at 1,740. Ichikoh was bid-only at 468 yen after closing at 423 yen on Wednesday.
Brokers added that activity in shares of other firms which are involved in the LCD business was helping Alps.
"Trade in Hosiden Corp, another LCD maker, has been active and the enthusiasm is spreading to Alps," a general manager at a medium-sized brokerage said. Hosiden was up 20 yen at 1,250.
